input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This expression redundantly combines a time period with “the time of”; use the concise time expression instead. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This refers to a concrete group of people in the past, so use the plural human-group noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，Here the mother notices an effect; 看 means “look,” while 看到 means “see” or “notice.” [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。他很小的时候，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a full noun phrase before using a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：所以他们搬家了，Both characters were named in the immediately preceding sentence, so a pronoun avoids unnecessarily repeating their names. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：他的同学们老是对他开玩笑，A habitual action with 老是 takes the zero particle, not completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：他没有朋友，因为他每天只祭拜，虽然 needs a contrasting result clause with 但是 or 可是; this sentence expresses a cause, so use 因为 to connect the reason. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
人 cannot refer to this concrete group of people here; 人们 is required by the teacher's rule.
看到 means to see or notice an effect, whereas 看 only means to look.
孟子 is first introduced here, so the character needs an introductory noun phrase before later pronoun reference.
The two people have just been identified, so 他们 is a clear and non-redundant reference.
老是 marks a habitual action, so sentence-final 了 is not appropriate.
Although there is no concessive contrast here, deleting 虽然 correctly leaves a cause-and-result explanation with 因为.
